APIProxy.name: orders-api
APIProxy.Description: Example proxy showing how to call SF-SAML-Extractor — which decodes an inbound SAML assertion and runs this proxy's ExtractVariables profile (EV-Extract-SAML-orders-api, defined inside the shared flow) — then SF-Signature-Router to sign a request payload as a JWT using one of the extracted claims. See ../../kvm for the matching KVM.
